entries.title: Epic: Impact Dynamics, Shaft Prestress, Hit Sweetness and Acoustics
entries.rationale: Physical and perceptual synthesis requires qualified downstream evidence. Theory/source review and synthesis of verified numerical results remain distinct executable work.

prerequisites.name: Qualified Tools/UpstreamDrift physical impact and radiation results with uncertainty
Controlled blinded perception evidence before any player-specific sweetness claim

acceptance: Synthesize positive, null, uncertain and unavailable outcomes in the existing heavy-hit article, preserving primary-source access limits.
Distinguish effective contact mass, ball impulse/energy, head rotation, hand vibration, radiated pressure and subjective preference.
Treat guitar-style modal damping and rotational prestress as testable mechanisms; never infer a player advantage from synthetic sound.
